About Flow

This view shows how Data Elements, Rules, and Extensions connect in your property. The diagram flows left to right: data elements feed into rules, and rules use extensions. Use the search box to focus on a specific component and see only its connections. Click any node in the diagram to open a list of its connections; click again or press Escape to clear the selection. For full lists and CSV exports, use the Rules, Data Elements, and Extensions tabs in the sidebar.
